notes: OVITO 3.17.2 reads extended XYZ periodicity and an out-of-cell second frame without wrapping or repeating frame 0.

mdcompress 1.0.0 is not on PyPI and conda is not installed. apt has no libxdrfile. The refresh-bio clone reports version 2.0.5, not 1.0.0. `make` stops on the example binaries with cc: error: unknown argument: '-fabi-version=6'. That is the 1.0.0 install failure, so the coordinate-only row is omitted.
chemfiles has no native CON format; the chemfiles-con row copies positions and the cell out of a chemfiles Frame filled from readcon.
chemfiles compression library /tmp/chemfiles-install/lib/libchemfiles.so opens {"bz2": true, "gz": true, "trr": true, "xz": true}
MDAnalysis 2.11.0 on DCD, XTC, NetCDF, TRR, XYZ and PDB. Cells are orthogonal, so the 2.11 triclinic wrap does not apply.

Reads and writes that do not call the readcon writer were timed on 6e0ffcd8ee291bdc6e58427d765b78efba4b5159. readcon CON, CON.gz, CON.zst, chemfiles and CON-bin writes were timed on f3ee0f471234e112209e6ad7623b2b6e5ce8a673. 83a34ca4 adds writer tests and a wrap pin and does not change that writer or the reader. The readcon write sample blocks are that later five-arm rotation; the order write lines are the original full rotation.
